propositions: Add a new discovery submodule under rebar.llm.review_kernel with immutable typed plan and result contracts that distinguish six outcome kinds (success, resumed, skipped, shed, failed, cancelled) instead of returning ambiguous values that cannot distinguish clean execution from failure modes.

The discovery executor performs synchronous dependency-aware scheduling with deterministic budget-driven shedding in ascending (rank, unit-id) order, ensuring identical shed sets across runs; units dependent on missing work are marked skipped with dependency reason.
When a local criterion fails, earlier independent successes are retained and later independent units continue; dependent units are skipped; dependent-unit failures do not erase prior successes.

A versioned, digest-complete checkpoint envelope covers material, code/ref, effective-policy snapshot, prompt, contract, model/mode, topology, dependencies, and schema version; only success and content-identical resumed units round-trip as reusable; failed, cancelled, skipped, and shed units remain missing.

Cancellation is observed before dispatch; in-flight non-interruptible calls already dispatched commit as their true outcome with real usage; not-yet-dispatched units are cancelled; systemic init/config failures abort remaining work with exact accounting.

Stored trace contains normalized outcome metadata and lineage (outcome codes, usage, ids) but excludes raw prompts, ticket bodies, provider responses, and secrets; review result schemas remain unchanged.
